name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
aliases: the young khan of the Mardu
description: The nineteen-year-old Mardu khan who won her war name at sixteen and defeats dragons in battle; she is called a boy by some but knows who she is.

timeline.summary: Alesha leads the Mardu horde in an ambush of six dragons from Kolaghan's brood in a canyon.
timeline.quote: Her arrow struck the first one in the mouth, sending a stray bolt of lightning harmlessly to the ground.

timeline.summary: A dragon's lightning breath terrifies Alesha, recalling the scars on her back from an earlier dragon, and she leaps from her horse.
timeline.quote: a memory of past terror, when another spawn of Kolaghan's brood had given her the scars she wore on her back.

timeline.summary: Alesha confronts the orc about holding back; he insults her as a human boy who thinks he is a woman.
timeline.quote: A human boy who thinks he's a woman?

timeline.summary: In a flashback, sixteen-year-old Alesha kills her first dragon with a spear and names herself Alesha, her grandmother's name, before the old khan and the horde.
timeline.quote: she pulled a spear from a dead man's back and plunged it into the beast's mouth, up into its brain.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, the old khan and horde shout Alesha's name without hesitation.
timeline.quote: And the whole gathered horde shouted "Alesha!" in reply.

timeline.summary: Alesha kills another dragon with a swing of her sword while it lunges at the nameless orc, and tells him to show who he is.
timeline.quote: I know who I am," Alesha said to him, still smiling. "Now show me who you are."

timeline.summary: After the battle, Alesha hears the warriors' deeds and shouts out each new war name.
timeline.quote: she shouted the name for the horde to hear—with never a moment's hesitation.

timeline.summary: Three warriors testify that the nameless orc saved their lives, and Alesha rebukes him for thinking his deeds are not glorious enough, telling him to learn his place before choosing a name.
timeline.quote: When you learn what your place among the Mardu is, then you can choose a name.

timeline.summary: The orc declares he knows Alesha and names her 'Alesha, Who Smiles at Death,' and the Mardu shout her name.
timeline.quote: and I call you Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

relations.note: She is the Mardu khan at nineteen.
relations.quote: she is the Mardu khan, as well as an expert rider, a fine archer, and a master of the sword.

relations.note: She is the young khan of the Mardu.
relations.quote: The young khan of the Mardu sat poised at the front of her horde

relations.note: She fights and kills Kolaghan's brood.
relations.quote: These were the dragons they sought, the filthy brood of the monstrous Kolaghan.

pages_say.description: The nineteen-year-old Mardu khan, an expert rider, archer, and swordswoman who scoffs at dragons.
The nineteen-year-old Mardu khan who won her war name at sixteen and defeats dragons in battle; she is called a boy by some but knows who she is.
